description: What's my best way there? For a goal — a major or a job — and what the person brings (courses, exams, their Competency Selfie, work and life experience), the paths to it, each saying WHY it ranks where it does and naming the figures that moved it. The steps appear only where an agreement or pathway document states them, never assembled from award levels alone. Every item the person brought is marked counted, not counted or needs review and appears in the answer: nothing is dropped silently. A path missing an input is ranked with that gap named rather than penalised invisibly.

goal.description: A major (a major_minor_id or CIP) or a job (a SOC code)

held.description: Optional: courses and exams, the shape will_my_credits_transfer takes

package.description: Optional: the agent-held GoldRibbon package, read by suggest_credit_for_my_learning. GoldSeam stores no copy

state.description: Optional two-letter state: where they are

name: find_my_best_pathway

paths.description: One per path: school, program, checklist, steps, credits left, cost, payback, and why it ranks where it does

steps.description: Shown only where an agreement or pathway document states them

what_you_brought.description: Every item, marked counted, not counted or needs review, each with its reason

title: Find My Best Pathway
